description: Total budget vectors: the budget reached exactly and by one unit over, counting spent, pending and committed, at I128_MAX, and lowered.

vectors.description: Two requests reserve exactly the total budget of 1000; the second is allowed with nothing to spare.
With 400 of the budget left, 401 is BUDGET_EXCEEDED, 400 is allowed, and then even 1 is refused.
Executed payouts stay counted: after 600 and 400 are paid the budget is spent, so 1 more is refused while 1000 is still held.
A PENDING payout reserves its charge: 501 is refused beside a pending 500, and a rejection gives the 500 back.
An APPROVED payout reserves its charge: 401 is refused beside a committed 600 and allowed once the principal cancels it.
In one request batch each item sees the reservations of the items before it: 401 is refused and 400 fills the budget.
With I128_MAX - 1 spent and 1 committed of an I128_MAX budget, charges of 1 and I128_MAX are BUDGET_EXCEEDED, never an overflow.
The budget can be lowered to exactly spent + pending + committed, and reserved payouts still execute without a budget check.
With 950 spent and reserved, a budget of 949 is BUDGET_BELOW_RESERVED and leaves the limits as they were; 950 is allowed.
